defect: Each team rendered its own <table> inside its own scroll container, so the two teams sized their columns independently and a long name in one pushed its numbers out of line with the other.
fix: ONE table, one shared colgroup, fixed table-layout, explicit column widths, two tbody row groups, tabular numerals, sticky player column below 720px.
pfColumn: absent — the engine records fouls but surfaces no foul-out, substitution or rotation consequence, so a PF column would read as a feature the game does not have
mvpRow: highlighted with a star and a raised background
regressionTest: e2e/phase8a-chaos.spec.js compares gold and blue cell offsets numerically
